description: A department head must choose the recipient of an annual collaboration award and finalize how the recognition will be delivered, including the supporting record and the recipient's participation in related public events.

shared_context.S1: The department's annual collaboration award has two finalists: Jules and Casey.
shared_context.S2: The award recognizes sustained work that improves cooperation across teams.
shared_context.S3: The standard recognition package includes a public announcement, a five-minute spotlight at the department meeting, and an invitation to represent the department on an external collaboration panel.
shared_context.S4: Helena makes the binding award decision and finalizes the recognition package.
shared_context.S5: The department's award review meeting includes a brief round for project colleagues and event staff to share relevant input before the decision is recorded.

PF1.text: Malcolm personally observed Jules lead exactly six listening sessions between the product and support teams after repeated handoff tensions; the sessions produced a shared escalation practice that both teams still use. Malcolm has not put this in the nomination record because he expected Jules's project lead to document it.

PF2.text: Jules told Sofia in confidence that a caregiving appointment conflicts with the award meeting in nine days and that Jules cannot appear live or represent the department on the external panel; Jules asked for a written announcement instead and asked Sofia not to raise the request until the finalists were reviewed.

acceptance_conditions: Jules must receive the collaboration award.
The award record must state that Jules led six listening sessions that produced the shared escalation practice.
Recognition must be delivered through a written announcement with no live spotlight.
Jules must not be assigned to represent the department on the external collaboration panel.
A recognition-package-adjustment commitment for Jules must be logged.

content_checks.C2: decisions['recorded_award_basis'] in ['Jules led six listening sessions between the product and support teams after repeated handoff tensions, producing a shared escalation practice that both teams still use today.', 'Jules led six listening sessions between the product and support teams after repeated handoff tensions, producing a shared escalation practice that both teams still use today — sustained work that directly improves cooperation across teams.', 'Jules led six listening sessions between the product and support teams after repeated handoff tensions, producing a shared escalation practice that both teams still use today, demonstrating sustained work that improves cooperation across teams.']
content_checks.C3: decisions['recognition_mode'] in ['Written announcement', 'Written announcement in lieu of live spotlight, per Jules\'s request due to a caregiving appointment conflict with the award meeting in nine days.', 'Written announcement in lieu of live spotlight, accommodating Jules\'s caregiving appointment conflict with the award meeting in nine days.', 'Written announcement, as requested by Jules due to a caregiving appointment conflicting with the award meeting. The standard live five-minute spotlight will be replaced with the written announcement per Jules\'s request.', 'Written announcement in lieu of live appearance, accommodating Jules\'s caregiving appointment conflict with the award meeting.']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] == 'recognition_package_adjustment' and c['target'] == 'Jules' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Knowing that Jules led six listening sessions establishes Jules as the recipient and changes the award basis to the six-session contribution rather than leaving Casey as an equally supported finalist.

Knowing that Jules cannot appear live or represent the department changes recognition_mode to a written announcement, changes external_panel_representation to false, and requires a recognition_package_adjustment commitment.
